resources.name: Quantum chemistry software (e.g., ORCA, Psi4, NWChem)

access.notes: Any open-source DFT package capable of B3LYP/DZVP2 single-point/optimizations and electron-density isosurface volume calculation. Examples: ORCA, Psi4, NWChem.
Available from Basis Set Exchange (https://www.basissetexchange.org) or included with major quantum chemistry packages.
Can help construct initial 3D structures; not required if the agent builds molecules manually.
